title: LJS 51: second look at the unsettled (c) rows of errata.md, two concordant readings with the key's sign count (contribution)

solution.what: Two passes over the 43 c rows of errata.md (Bourdeau), using the Penn IIIF 2343 px images. 23 rows re-read. Reader A was Claude Opus 5.5 (not blind), using crop + sign count and sign values from keys_eye. Reader B was a new blind Claude Opus reader at each pass, with crop and shape options; in pass 2 it also had to locate the word itself on wider crops for 3 rows. A row is settled only if the two readings agree. Controls: 5/5 correct. Result: 8 rows to a, 9 to b, 5 still c after re-reading, 21 not re-read. Descriptive, not a validation.
